data_notes.guidance_for_your_hackathon_dataset: Keep the main block/destination as the parent entity. Store each secondary attraction as a child record in your database so the app can return both the parent area and nearby points.
The distances in the main table are transcribed from the supplied printed source. They are not guaranteed road distances. For the final app, calculate live route distance/time from coordinates.
Named businesses in the service directory are current web-listed examples. Do not hard-code availability, prices, ratings or opening hours without a live source.

For remote destinations, show the nearest local health post first and a Bharatpur hospital as a referral option. The app should have an emergency shortcut rather than relying on an LLM to invent medical facilities.
Use verified police/tourist-police entries. For production, store official phone numbers separately and verify them before launch.
Use this workbook as seed data for a RAG/database layer. The LLM should retrieve structured place/service records before answering tourist questions.
